speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm confused. Was there some sort of peer review committee to determine which scientists would be included?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Peer review? It's People magazine. People picked me.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: What people?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: The people from People.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yeah, but exactly who are these people? What are their credentials, how are they qualified, what makes accidentally noticing a hunk of rock that's been traipsing around the solar system for billions of years more noteworthy than any other scientific accomplishment made by someone under thirty?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Boy, I bet Ellen Pages friends aren't giving her this kind of crap.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Are you proud of yourself?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: In general, yes.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, there's my missing neutrino. You were hiding from me as an unbalanced charge, weren't you, you little subatomic Dickens?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Hi Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Here, look, look, I found my missing neutrino.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh, good, we can take it off the milk cartons.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, we're going to go apologise to Raj and invite him out to dinner.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Apologise, for what?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, he came over last night with some pretty good news, and we weren't very supportive.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I sense you're trying to tell me something.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You were a colossal ass-hat.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh! No, I beg to differ. Of the three of us, I was by far the most supportive.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Really, do tell.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: How will Raj ever reach true greatness if his friends lower the bar for him? When I was eleven, my sister bought our father a" world's greatest dad" coffee mug, and frankly the man coasted until the day he died.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, let's try it this way, what if the People magazine thing is the best Raj is ever going to achieve?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I had not considered that.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Come on.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I often forget other people have limitations. It's so sad.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: He can feel sadness?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Not really, it's what you and I would call condescension. And when we go in there, let's show Raj that we're happy for him.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: But I'm not.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Well then fake it. Look at me, I could be grinding on the fact that without my stabilizing telescope mount he never would have found that stupid little clump of cosmic schmutz, but I'm bigger than that.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Fine, what do you want me to do?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Smile.
